context_for_next_testing_agent: MySQL is intentionally not connected to test degraded mode. The health endpoint works correctly. Frontend handles DB down gracefully. The main issue is that public API endpoints (/api/city/events, /api/city/ads/active, /api/news/, /api/news/breaking) return 500 errors instead of empty lists when DB is down. This needs to be fixed in the backend routers.
rca_of_the_issue: The public endpoints in city.py and news.py use `db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)` which throws an exception when the database is unavailable. The endpoints don't have try-except blocks to catch these exceptions and return graceful empty responses. The fix requires wrapping the DB queries in try-except blocks and returning empty lists on connection errors.
